clauses.reason: The order exempts Ovilup H. George, chief pipefitter and fire chief, Government Printing Office, from compulsory retirement for age under section 204 of the act of June 30, 1932, and fixes the period in its own words: "for a period of one year ending February 28, 1942". The end is recorded as February 28, 1942 (1942-02-28), inclusive: the exemption runs through that day. The exclusive reading, under which it ends when that day begins, is the alternative.
